(b) Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the Administrative Agent or the Initial Borrower reasonably determines in good faith,
with consent by the other not to be unreasonably withheld, that the circumstances described in clause (a)(i) of this Section 2.12 have arisen (other than with respect to the Term SOFR Rate or Term CORRA) (and such circumstances are unlikely to

Alternative Currency Term Benchmark Rate with an alternate benchmark rate (including any mathematical or other adjustments to the benchmark (if any) incorporated therein) that is either

“ Swap Agreement ” means (a) any and all rate swap transactions, basis swaps, credit derivative
transactions, forward rate transactions, commodity swaps, commodity options, forward commodity contracts, equity or equity index swaps or options, bond or bond price or bond index swaps or options or forward bond or forward bond price or forward
bond index transactions, interest rate options, forward foreign exchange transactions, cap transactions, floor transactions, collar transactions, currency swap transactions, cross-currency rate swap transactions, currency options, spot contracts, or
any other similar transactions or any combination of any of the foregoing (including any options to enter into any of the foregoing), whether or not any such transaction is governed by or subject to any master agreement, and (b) any and all
transactions of any kind, and the related confirmations, which are subject to the terms and conditions of, or governed by, any form of master agreement published by the International Swaps and Derivatives Association, Inc., any International Foreign
Exchange Master Agreement, or any other master agreement (any such master agreement, together with any related schedules, a “ Master Agreement ”), including any such obligations or liabilities under any Master Agreement.

rawModelOutput.overallNotes:
[
"This submission covers Section 1.01 defined terms from 'Junior Lien Intercreditor Agreement' through 'Master Agreement' - a pure alphabetical definitions batch, not a quantitative covenant; accordingly no WireRule or WireSharedCapacity outputs were produced, only WireDefinition entries (one per distinct term, per the multiple-definitions extraction requirement).",
"The FROZEN SEMANTIC INVENTORY reported an INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP (109 items accepted, large unaccounted source stretches, and a failed gap re-inventory call) without ever surfacing concrete inventoryItemIds to this compiler; consequently no inventoryItemIds could be attached to any node and inventoryDispositions is empty - this gap itself is flagged here rather than silently ignored.",
"Three terms remain MISSING_CONTEXT after genuine tool attempts: 'LCT Election' and 'LCT Test Date' (Section 1.08(a) resolved only to its chapeau, not the defining sub-clauses (a)(i)-(iii)), and 'Market Convention Rate' (Section 2.12(b) resolved but truncated before reaching the defining language, with the substance apparently in sub-clauses (b)(i)/(ii)).",
"'Junior Lien Intercreditor Agreement' is marked PARTIAL because it incorporates by reference Exhibit E-3 (no such EXHIBIT node exists in the package - known MISSING_SCHEDULE dependency) and contemplates an Intercreditor Agreement document type that is entirely absent from the package (known REFERENCED_DOCUMENT_ABSENT dependency).",
"'Loan Documents' is marked PARTIAL solely because of its internal carve-out referencing Section 9.02 and Section 2.07(f), both OUT_OF_SCOPE due to source-context budget exhaustion; the core enumeration of Loan Documents itself is otherwise complete.",
"'Loan Modification Offer' and 'Master Agreement' were successfully upgraded from bare pointers to COMPLETE by following the retrieval-before-giving-up policy: getReferencedProvision resolved Section 2.22(a)'s own defining text, and getDefinition resolved 'Swap Agreement' which itself contains the operative Master Agreement parenthetical.",
"'Market Capitalization' is the only term in this batch with real arithmetic (shares outstanding x offering price per share); both factors are transaction-specific facts not fixed contractual metrics, so they were modeled as TRANSACTION_INPUT_REFERENCE nodes multiplied together, per the schema's guidance for values that are inputs at the time of a specific transaction rather than named financial metrics."
]
